narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for 'Brand's Lutein EX' health supplement. It uses a lighthearted, family-oriented narrative where a daughter expresses amazement at her mother's high level of focus and busy lifestyle. The mother then attributes her eye health and sustained concentration to the '20-20-20' rule and her 'secret weapon,' the lutein supplement. The purpose is to build brand trust and encourage viewers to purchase the product to maintain eye health under high-intensity activities.
